native_version_fix.change: Two native Hermes CLI version invocations use the supported --version flag. No agent behavior, adapter class or credential flow changed.

hermes.native_install_note: Native Harbor passes --branch with the timestamped canary tag to the moving main installer. The stable September tag is incompatible with the current pm bootstrap. Runtime HEAD is checked before solving. Bootstrap and dependency retrieval remain moving parts.
hermes.runtime_check: Native AGENT_START hook verifies checkout HEAD against the resolved release commit before solving

model.route_policy: OpenRouter default routing for this model. Provider may vary between compatible endpoints

agent.max_turns_source: Harbor v0.23.0 native Hermes adapter hardcodes this config value and exposes no max_turns option
treatment_delivery: Harbor agent.skills registers the containing directory for Hermes discovery

cost.accounting: OpenRouter lifetime metadata before and after each slot. Harbor-reported cost is retained separately when present

task_toml:
schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "workpaperbench/{task_id}"
description = "Deterministic workpaper preparation and verification"
authors = []
keywords = ["accounting", "workpaper"]

[agent]
timeout_sec = 600.0
network_mode = "allowlist"
allowed_hosts = ["openrouter.ai"]

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 180.0
environment_mode = "separate"
network_mode = "no-network"

[environment]
build_timeout_sec = 900.0
cpus = 2
memory_mb = 4096
network_mode = "public"

[verifier.environment]
network_mode = "no-network"
verifier_network: Native tests/docker-compose.yaml main.network_mode=none, checked by loopback-only interface inventory and failed external TLS probe
